name: Tricholoma matsutake
notes: Medium-distance fringe type at genus level [13]; a mycorrhizal fairy ring, reported (unchecked) to form a dense white soil colony ("shiro") and to be partly harmful to its host roots. Not cultivated. Tricholoma rings advance about 17 cm/year and the matsutake mat is up to 15 cm deep (research/02 [24]).

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): its colony in soil (the shiro) is reported to advance 10 to 20 cm a year; 15 cm a year is 17 um/h

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
